_comment: DUNGEON RUN relics. Kept for the whole run. PLACEHOLDERS: Claude made these twelve so events and elites have relics to give. Ben: rename them, rewrite them, add more. Each relic can have 'onPickup' effects (once, when you get it) and 'atFightStart' effects (at the start of every fight, after you draw). Fight-start effects use the same keywords as cards.

relics.name: Ember in a Jar
relics.text: At the start of each fight, apply Burn 3 to ALL enemies.

relics.name: Gravedigger's Spade
relics.text: Start each fight with a Skeleton already summoned.

relics.name: The Black Candle
relics.text: Start each fight with 2 extra energy and 1 extra card.

relics.name: Tallow Stub
relics.text: Heal 4 at the start of each fight.

relics.name: Bone Dice
relics.text: At the start of each fight, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.

relics.name: Hunter's Chalk
relics.text: At the start of each fight, apply Mark of Rot 1 to ALL enemies.

relics.name: A Saint's Finger Bone
relics.text: Start each fight with 2 Bone Walls already summoned.

relics._comment: The Ancient Tree's relics. eventOnly: never offered at random, only by the event.
relics.name: Tree Soul
relics.text: Every 5 cards you play, deal 10 damage to a random enemy.

relics.name: Bound Wood Creature
relics.text: At the start of each fight, apply 1 Tangled to ALL enemies and deal 6 damage to ALL enemies. (An enemy with any Tangled takes 6 damage at the end of its turn.)
